title: FIX MY BOOKS
description: This mod adds the ability to fix empty or broken enchanted books in the grindstone. Tired of having structures generated only to find that the books inside the chest are all broken and have no enchants? FIX MY BOOKS solves that!
body:
Are you tired of finding enchanted books deep in the minecraft earth in the most unforsaken places that sunlight will never reach; only to find that the books you managed to get away with have **NO ENCHANTS?** 

Well I have the solution for YOU! Introducing: FIX MY BOOKS!

The mod that lets you put a broken enchant book into a grindstone to finally reveal what that pesky enchant book was hiding from you all along. 

This mod should be compatible with custom enchants from other mods as well as vanilla enchants too! 

Safe to add or remove anytime during your gameplay! 

_(Built in Forge 47.4.20 for 1.20.1. Not tested in other versions.)_
